items: This module tests whether simple options stay concise and numbered options split cleanly into new lines.

quizData.question: Scenario 1 (Simple Options): What is the primary metric for measuring record count balance across groups?
explanations: Class Imbalance measures the sheer volume of representation across groups.
Disparate Impact evaluates post-training prediction ratios.
DPL measures historical label proportion gaps.
Treatment Equality checks the ratio of false positives to false negatives.

quizData.question: Scenario 2 (Numbered Multi-Step Options): What is the recommended sequence to handle high Class Imbalance?
options: 1. Perform EDA to confirm representation gap.2. Apply SMOTE oversampling on the minority group.3. Retrain model and evaluate performance.
1. Deploy the unmitigated model directly.2. Log predictions to CloudWatch.3. Wait for feedback.
1. Delete all records from the privileged group.2. Retrain model with remaining data.
1. Ignore pre-training metrics.2. Rely exclusively on Post-Training Treatment Equality.
explanations: 1. EDA identifies the gap early.2. Oversampling balances minority representation.3. Retraining validates the fix.
Deleting data destroys valuable model inputs.
Pre-training metrics should never be ignored.
